description: This Java source file defines a custom ArrayAdapter (CustomArrayAdapter) for use with Android ListView components. It manages a collection of ListItemObject instances, provides stable IDs for items, and overrides the getView method to populate ListView items with images and text, including bitmap processing for circular cropping.

classes.name: CustomArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter for ListItemObject items, providing stable IDs and custom view handling including circular bitmap cropping.

methods.name: CustomArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, layout resource ID, and data list, and setting up stable IDs.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item at the specified position.

methods.name: updateStableIds
methods.description: Clears and repopulates the map of item IDs based on current data.

methods.name: addStableIdForDataAtPosition
methods.description: Assigns a new stable ID to data item at specified position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for a list item, populates it with the item's data, and applies circular cropping to the bitmap.

methods.name: getCroppedBitmap
methods.description: Returns a circular cropped version of the given bitmap.
